scriptLines: admission_date = coalesce(   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy') ),

discharge_date = coalesce(   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy') ),

department = case(   lower(trim(department)) == 'onco' || lower(trim(department)) == 'oncology' || lower(trim(department)) == 'oncologyy', 'Oncology',   lower(trim(department)) == 'cardiolgy' || lower(trim(department)) == 'cardiology', 'Cardiology',   lower(trim(department)) == 'emergancy' || lower(trim(department)) == 'emergency' || lower(trim(department)) == 'er', 'Emergency',   lower(trim(department)) == 'generalsurgery' || lower(trim(department)) == 'general surgery' || lower(trim(department)) == 'gen surg', 'General Surgery',   lower(trim(department)) == 'paediatrics' || lower(trim(department)) == 'pediatrics', 'Pediatrics',   lower(trim(department)) == 'neurology', 'Neurology',   isNull(department) || trim(department) == '' || upper(trim(department)) == 'NULL', toString(null()),   trim(department) ),
attending_doctor_id = iif(isNull(attending_doctor_id) || trim(attending_doctor_id) == '' || upper(trim(attending_doctor_id)) == 'NULL', toString(null()), trim(attending_doctor_id))) ~> derivedColumn1
